body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application.

br.br:
1. (Canceled)
2. (Currently Amended) An intravascular device, comprising:
a stylet comprising an elongate member having a proximal end, a distal end, and an inner lumen extending between the proximal end and the distal end;
a sensor disposed on the distal end of the stylet and configured to detect and measure a physiological parameter in a patient's vasculature;
a hub having an inner lumen for receiving the stylet;
a guard extending from a distal end of the hub, and having an inner lumen for receiving and stabilizing the stylet; and
a connector assembly proximal to the stylet, configured for connecting one or more elements of the stylet to a computing device;
wherein a distal portion of the stylet is more flexible than a proximal portion of the stylet.
3. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the stylet comprises a plurality of sensors disposed on the distal end.
4. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 3, wherein the plurality of sensors comprises one or more selected from an ultrasound transducer, a pressure sensor, a temperature sensor, an optical sensor, a biosensor, or one or more combinations thereof.
5. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 4, wherein the biosensor comprises an ECG electrode.
6. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein, the hub is configured to engage with the stylet wherein when in an engaged configuration, a rotation applied to the hub can cause a rotation to the stylet.
7. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the hub and the connector assembly are configured to allow relative movement between them so that movement of the hub does not cause movement of at least the portion of the connector assembly.
8. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the hub is configured to removably engage with the connector assembly so that the hub and connector assembly can rotate together, and wherein the connector assembly further comprises a stabilizing portion that rotates independent of the connector assembly such that the connection to the computing device is stable when the hub and connector assembly rotate.
9. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the connector assembly is configured to attach or plug into a port in a computer.
10. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the connector assembly is configured to attach to one or more cords or wires that attach to or plug into a computer.
11. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the intravascular device has a length L1 and the stylet has a length L2, wherein L2 is less than Li.
12. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 11, wherein is L1 is about two times L2.
13. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the one or more elements comprise a coaxial cable that connects to an ultrasound transducer.
14. (Previously Presented) The intravascular device of claim 2, wherein the one or more elements comprise an electrical conductor comprising a conductive wire that connects to an ECG electrode.
15. (New) The intravascular device of claim 2, further comprising a ring electrode disposed at the distal end of the elongate member.
16. (New) The intravascular device of claim 15, wherein the sensor is further disposed at a distal end of the ring electrode.
17. (New) The intravascular device of claim 16, further comprising a first electrical conductor configured to convey an electrocardiogram signal from the ring electrode to the computing device.
18. (New) The intravascular device of claim 17, further comprising a second electrical conductor configured to convey a signal from the sensor to the computing device, wherein the first electrical conductor and the second electrical conductor are disposed within the inner lumen of the elongate member.
19. (New) The intravascular device of claim 18, further comprising a first encapsulating member forming a first enclosure around the sensor.
20. (New) The intravascular device of claim 19, further comprising a second encapsulating member forming a second enclosure around the sensor and the first encapsulating member, wherein the second encapsulating member is attached to the ring electrode, and wherein the second encapsulating member forms a fluid-tight seal between the sensor and the ring electrode.
